newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatia revises results of 42-day T-bill sale.
newsitem.headline: Croatia revises results of 42-day T-bill sale.

text.p: Croatia's finance ministry said on Tuesday it raised 38.3 million kuna, rather than 30.3 million as it said earlier, through 42-day treasury bills at an unchanged rate of 11 percent.
The issue was priced at 98,750 kuna.
The ministry had offered 90 million kuna T-bills, but bids fell short of the targeted amount. Some 61 percent of the bidders came from the banking sector, it said in a statement.
The weighted average was 10.91 percent. The bills are payable in two days and mature on February 20.
Croatia will next auction 100 million kuna worth of 42-day bills on January 21. -- Zoran Radosavljevic, Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
